ctx.x: It’s our method of reproduction. I mean the roots for that song, what was his name, J. Berni Barbour — anyway, you know “My Man Rocks Me (With One Steady Roll).” That was out there in 1921. And if the parents who objected to rhythm & blues being re-named rock & roll, if they only knew.
They would have thrown those 45s out in the garbage.
